results.title: Hybrid deep learning framework for heart disease ...
results.content: To overcome these obstacles, researchers, physicians, and data scientists should work together to make deep learning models that are both accurate and easy to understand, to standardize and improve data quality, and to ensure that ECG signal images are used to predict heart disease, they are adopted based on artificial intelligence methods. An evaluation of the overall correctness of the model in predicting heart disease based on the input ECG signals is the primary focus of the accuracy analysis of the Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Heart Disease prediction utilizing ECG signal pictures. By combining the advantages of several architectures (e.g., CNN, RNN), the model can improve predictive power and accuracy in identifying heart illnesses from ECG signal images using a hybrid deep learning technique. In conclusion, there is a lot of potential for enhancing healthcare efficiency and diagnostic accuracy with the Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Heart Disease prediction utilizing ECG signal images.
